description: JSON shape for BasketCandidate and AdversarialExample records. Zod mirrors live in lib/basket-formula-corpus/schema.ts.

BasketCandidate.exactSourceSpan: string (verbatim or whitespace-equivalent substring of cited document)

amountOrFormulaCandidate.structured: optional { fixedDollar?, percentage?, metric?, ratioTest?, components? }

BasketCandidate.capacityComputable: boolean — true only when affirmative AND all required inputs/conditions are present in-corpus
BasketCandidate.capacityComputationBlockers: string[] — required when affirmative but not computable

AdversarialExample.role: COMPARATOR_THRESHOLD | APPROVAL_OR_CONSENT_TRIGGER | FINANCIAL_MAINTENANCE_TEST | DEFAULT_OR_EVENT_THRESHOLD | INTEREST_RATE_FORMULA | DEFINITION_DE_MINIMIS_EXCLUSION | AFFIRMATIVE_CAPACITY_CONTROL

invariants: Do not set capacityComputable=true when financial inputs or conditions are missing.
Do not treat bare dollar/% figures as AFFIRMATIVE_CAPACITY without source-supported permission semantics.
exactSourceSpan must ground in sourceVersion.documentPath (raw or whitespace-normalized).
Production capacity engine paths under lib/contract-model/runtime/capacity remain untouched.
